name: mutex
algorithm: t workers (Mk: tasks; Go: goroutines; C, Rust and Zig: OS threads) each lock one shared std mutex n times and add 1 to the count under it; prints the count, t * n. Variants: contended (8 workers) and uncontended (1 worker) (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the count stays below 2^31; the task has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the count, t * n, shows every locked add happened
notes: Concurrency row (B19): mask 0x5555 (one logical CPU per physical core), 8 threads, as std-sync2/atomicadd. The contended variant prices each lock's slow path (spin, park, wake), the uncontended one its fast path.
